lines.en: label sanaspring1:
scene noonsky
Before I know it, the sun begins to set. And just like I’ve done a million times before, I waste away my school day pretending that I don’t deserve a thousand needles beneath my nails.
lines.zh: 不知不觉，太阳开始西沉。就像我做过无数次的那样，我虚度掉学校的一天，假装自己不该受指甲缝里扎上千根针的罪。

lines.en: But on the bright side, my inability to smile has cascaded into a glorious spectacle providing hours and hours of entertainment for a bunch of girls who are young enough to be my daughters.
lines.zh: 但往好了想，我笑不出来的样子已经演变成一场壮观的表演，给一群年轻得能当我女儿的女孩提供了成百上千小时的娱乐。

lines.en: Meanwhile, the two girls who are {i}like{/i} daughters to me begin to panic and worry as I replace my manic Monday with one of melancholy.
lines.zh: 与此同时，那两个对我而言{i}如同{/i}女儿的女孩开始慌张、开始担心，因为我把狂躁的星期一换成了一个忧郁的星期一。

lines.en: What I mean is I’m missing calls from Ayane now as well. And while it would be infinitely easier to just turn off my phone, I like the attention. I like knowing they’re worried.
lines.zh: 我的意思是，现在我连 Ayane 的电话也漏接了。虽然关掉手机要省事一万倍，但我喜欢这种被关注的感觉。我喜欢知道她们在担心我。

lines.en: It’s a beautiful contrast to these four, who seem more inclined to rebuild the status quo from the ground up rather than attempt to reconstruct it.
lines.zh: 这和眼前这四位形成了美妙的对比——她们似乎更倾向于从零开始重建现状，而不是试图去修复它。

lines.en: I’m sure there’s another life in which I’d choose differently. And in that life (Or lives, if I’m fortunate enough to find myself conscious in even more places), I hope that choice makes me happy.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，在另一个人生里我会做出不同的选择。而在那个人生里（或者那些人生里，如果我足够幸运，能在更多地方保有意识的话），我希望那个选择能让我幸福。

lines.en: Because I’m sure it’s obvious, but right now, I can’t come close to saying that’s the way I feel.
lines.zh: 因为我敢肯定这很明显——但现在，我根本说不出自己有那种感觉。

lines.en: This whole trip has been a game of charades in which I pretend I didn’t destroy the world.
lines.zh: 整趟旅程就是一场猜字谜游戏，我在里面假装自己没有毁掉这个世界。

lines.en: It is a game that I have lost.
lines.zh: 而我输了这场游戏。

lines.en: So let my premature death be a warning to all of you-
lines.zh: 所以，让我过早的死亡成为对你们所有人的警告吧——

lines.en: : Sensei!
lines.zh: : 老师！

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome1
If you know you don’t deserve something, just leave it alone.
lines.zh: 如果你明知自己不配拥有某样东西，就别去碰它。

lines.en: Black sheep can’t blend in with cats.
lines.zh: 黑羊是混不进猫群里的。

lines.en: : You zoning out again? We didn’t push you too hard, did we?
lines.zh: : 你又走神了？我们没把你逼得太狠吧？

lines.en: : You did, actually. But any amount of pushing is too hard when your body feels like it’s been hit by a truck.
lines.zh: : 你们逼得挺狠的。不过在身体像被卡车撞过一样的情况下，再轻的推搡都算太狠。

lines.en: : Being hit by a truck would likely to be preferable to your current situation, Sir. If there’s anything I’ve learned from anime, it’s that truck fatalities are typically a blessing in disguise.
lines.zh: : 被卡车撞大概比您现在的处境好得多，先生。要说我从动���里学到了什么，那就是死于车祸通常是因祸得福。

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome2
: Molly, stop. You’re gonna give him ideas.
lines.zh: : Molly，别说了。你会给他出主意的。

lines.en: : All I’m saying is it would greatly increase his chances of creating an elf harem.
lines.zh: : 我只是说，那样能大大提高他组建精灵后宫的几率。

lines.en: : Now you’re going to give Futaba ideas.
lines.zh: : 现在你要给 Futaba 出主意了。

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome3
: I can’t believe I actually missed you.
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信我居然会想你。

lines.en: : Ignoring Futaba’s elf fetish, {i}please{/i} don’t get hit by a truck on the way home. Because I’d probably blame myself for dragging you around and it would weigh on me for the rest of my life.
lines.zh: : 先不管 Futaba 的精灵癖，回家的路上{i}请{/i}别被卡车撞。因为我大概会把责任揽到自己身上，怪我把你拖来拖去，然后一辈子都背着这个包袱。

lines.en: : Agreed, Sir! And thank you for escorting us back to the dorms. It is at this point where I would ideally like to give you a quest reward. But unfortunately, all I have on me are the clothes on my back.
lines.zh: : 同意，先生！还有，感谢您护送我们回宿舍。按理说这时候我该给您一个任务奖励。但不巧的是，我身上只有这身衣服。

lines.en: : I’ll take the tie. I can use it to hang myself later.
lines.zh: : 那我要那条领带。回头可以用它上吊。

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome4
: That isn’t funny, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 那不好笑，老师。

lines.en: : It’d be best to remember who you’re talking to when you make {i}jokes{/i} like that, Sir.
lines.zh: : 先生，开这种{i}玩笑{/i}最好先想清楚你在跟谁说话。

lines.en: : Oh...shit. Molly, I forgot. I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 哦……操。Molly，我忘了。抱歉。

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome5
: Hah...‘tis fine. Just use your hearthstone and get some rest. We all know you’re having a tough go of it right now. And I’m sure being around us didn’t help at all.
lines.zh: : 哈……没事的。用你的炉石回去休息吧。我们都知道你现在很不好过。而我们肯定也没帮上什么忙。

lines.en: : Is there something you’d like to add, Sana? You’re the only one who still looks like they want to kill me.
lines.zh: : Sana，你有什么要补充的吗？只有你还一脸想杀了我的样子。

lines.en: : No dying allowed...that’s my biggest and...only rule...
lines.zh: : 不许死……这是我最大、也是……唯一的规定……

lines.en: : At the risk of accidentally offending {i}you{/i} as well, I’ll just nod and agree.
lines.zh: : 冒着不小心又冒犯到{i}你{/i}的风险，我还是点头同意好了。

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome6
: Do you need us to call you a cab, Sensei? Because I assume you won’t be coming inside.
lines.zh: : 老师，需要帮你叫辆出租车吗？我猜你不会进去吧。

lines.en: : Well, if he does it in the cab, it’ll just...oh. Never mind. I greatly misunderstood where that sentence was going.
lines.zh: : 嗯，如果他要在出租车里做那件事，那就……哦。算了。我完全误会这句话的走向了。

lines.en: : Ignore her.
lines.zh: : 别理她。

lines.en: : I’ll be fine. But thanks for offering. And apologies again for being terrible company and making you all feel terrible about yourselves today.
lines.zh: : 我没事的。不过谢谢你们的好意。还有，再次抱歉今天当了个糟糕的旅伴，还让你们都对自己感觉很糟糕。

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome7
: God, you’re like...even worse than Io right now. Please get better soon, Sensei. I really hate seeing you like this.
lines.zh: : 天哪，你现在……比 Io 还糟糕。请快点好起来，老师。我真的不想看你这样子。

lines.en: : We all do. But I suppose we’ve done all we can today and...all that’s left is to...wait and see if you call us.
lines.zh: : 我们都不想。不过我想今天我们已经尽力了……剩下的只有……等着看你会不会打给我们。

lines.en: : Which you can do any time you want, Sir. The offer to stay with the Kendo Princess and me stands.
lines.zh: : 您随时都可以打，先生。来和剑道公主还有我住在一起的提议依然有效。

lines.en: : I’ll keep that in mind. And I’ll see you guys around. Hopefully under better circumstances.
lines.zh: : 我会记着的。那回头见。希望是在更好的情况下。

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome8
: A...Actually...would you want to...walk with me? I have work, so...I’m not going back to the dorms just yet...
lines.zh: : 那、那个……你愿意……陪我走一段吗？我还要上班，所以……我暂时不回宿舍……

lines.en: : Like...just you two alone?
lines.zh: : 就……你和他两个人？

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome9
: Is that...weird?...Don’t we all...hang out with Sensei alone at times?...
lines.zh: : 那样……很奇怪吗？……我们不也……都有单独和老师待在一起的时候吗？……

lines.en: : It’s not weird. Just wondering.
lines.zh: : 不奇怪。就是问问。

lines.en: : I’d be open to walking with you as well, Zagull. We can talk more about the mechanics for your new arm.
lines.zh: : Zagull，我也很乐意陪你走。我们可以多聊聊你那条新手臂的机制。

lines.en: : That’s...nice, but...
lines.zh: : 那……很好，不过……

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome10
: I kind of...just want it to be Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我有点……只想和老师一起……

lines.en: : Oh. Well, I guess I’ll just fuck myself then.
lines.zh: : 哦。那我猜我还是自己去解决好了。

lines.en: : Is that...okay?
lines.zh: : 这样……可以吗？

lines.en: : You just have to stop by the bar, right? You’re not going to drag me to some sort of pit-stop along the way where I’ll have to talk about my {i}feelings?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你只是要顺路去趟酒吧，对吧？你不会在路上把我拽进什么休息站，逼我谈谈我的{i}感受{/i}吧？

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome11
: I think...that’d just make me late, so...we can pass on the...feelings...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……那样会让我迟到，所以……我们可以跳过……感受……

lines.en: : Then sure. It’s not like one more detour is going to make any sort of difference when I’m going to be mur-
lines.zh: : 那成交。反正再多绕一段路也没什么差别，反正我一到家就要被谋——

lines.en: : When I’m going to be severely punished the moment I get home.
lines.zh: : 就要被狠狠惩罚一顿了。

lines.en: : Nice save...
lines.zh: : 圆得漂亮……

lines.en: scene black
Futaba, Rin, and Molly head inside after waving goodbye to the two of us and...suddenly, I’m alone with Sana for the first time since-
lines.zh: Futaba、Rin 和 Molly 挥手告别后走进去了……突然间，我第一次和 Sana 独处了，自从——

lines.en: scene fuckherdoityoupussydoit35
scene fuckherdoityoupussydoit39
scene fuckherdoityoupussydoit14
scene walkingsanahome12
For the first time in a while.
lines.zh: 是很久以来的第一次。

lines.en: But it’s not just because it’s been so long that things feel different now.
lines.zh: 但事情之所以感觉不同，不只是因为隔了这么久。

lines.en: Sana is...well, she doesn’t feel the way she used to. And {i}I{/i} no longer feel like it’s my duty to protect her whenever she’s by my side.
lines.zh: Sana 是……嗯，她给我的感觉和从前不一样了。{i}我{/i}也不再觉得，只要她在我身边，我就有义务保护她。

lines.en: And frankly, that’s a good thing. Because I wouldn’t even be able to protect a kitten in my current state. Or an egg. Or anything else that needs to be handled with care.
lines.zh: 说实话，这是件好事。因为我现在的样子，连只小猫都保护不了。或者一个鸡蛋。或者任何需要小心轻放的东西。

lines.en: But it’s not like I can rely on her to protect me either the way I could with, like...Ami or...Ayane or...Niki. Or even Chika when she’s not shopping for concrete.
lines.zh: 但我也不能指望她来保护我，像 Ami 或者……Ayane 或者……Niki 那样。甚至 Chika 也行，只要她不在挑水泥。

lines.en: She’s a girl I can kind of just exist with.
lines.zh: 她是个我可以只是……待在一起的女孩。

lines.en: scene fuckherdoityoupussydoit14
scene fuckherdoityoupussydoit39
scene fuckherdoityoupussydoit14
scene fuckherdoityoupussydoit39
scene walkingsanahome12
No she’s not. I can’t exist with her at all.
lines.zh: 不，她不是。我根本没法只是和她待在一起。

lines.en: : You’ve been...really quiet ever since we left the dorms, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 老师……我们从宿舍出来以后你就一直很安静……

lines.en: : I was quiet before that too. I’m being held against my will right now.
lines.zh: : 在那之前我也很安静。我现在是被你强行押着的。

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome13
: Is that so?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : You really think a girl my size could ever hold someone like {i}you{/i} against your will? If anything...wouldn’t it normally be the other way around?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得我这种体型的女孩，能强行押住{i}你{/i}这样的人吗？要说的话……正常情况下不是应该反过来吗？

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : Probably?
lines.zh: : 大概吧？

lines.en: : I’m not really sure what else you expect me to say there.
lines.zh: : 我真不知道你还想让我说什么。

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome14
: I wasn’t expecting anything in particular...I just think it’s a little weird seeing you so...different all of a sudden. It feels strange being the...more confident one out of the two of us...
lines.zh: : 我没指望你特意说什么……我只是觉得，突然看到你这么……不一样，有点奇怪。在我们两个之间，变成……更自信的那个人，这感觉很陌生……

lines.en: : Yeah, well...confidence for me was never much of a strong suit to begin with. I’ve moreso just been a staunch believer of “fake it ‘til you make it.”
lines.zh: : 是啊，唉……自信本来就不是我的强项。我倒不如说一直是个“装到成真为止”的坚定信徒。

lines.en: : I think...that’s a perfectly fine strategy to have. But I’d still like it if you could get back to your old self soon.
lines.zh: : 我觉得……这是个完全没问题的策略。但我还是希望你早点变回原来的样子。

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome12
: Yeah, well...so would I.
lines.zh: : 是啊，唉……我也想。

lines.en: : Why not talk about it? We’re alone now...and I’ve yet to give up any of your...{i}secrets...{/i}
lines.zh: : 为什么不谈谈呢？现在我们独处了……而且我还没泄露过你的任何……{i}秘密{/i}……

lines.en: scene fuckherdoityoupussydoit14
scene fuckherdoityoupussydoit39
scene walkingsanahome12
: Do you actually want to talk about that stuff? Or is there something else you want instead?
lines.zh: : 你真的想谈那些事吗？还是说你想要点别的？

lines.en: : I don’t care what we talk about...I’m just happy to be with you again.
lines.zh: : 我不在乎我们聊什么……我只是很高兴又能和你在一起。

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome15
: I’ve had a lot of time to think while you’ve been gone...a lot of time to, like...self-reflect, I guess? And I think I agree with what everyone’s been saying about how I’ve been changing lately.
lines.zh: : 你不在的这段时间，我有很多时间思考……很多时间，怎么说呢……自我反省吧？我想我同意大家最近说的、关于我在改变的说法。

lines.en: : There was a lot of stuff I said before I knew you very well that...doesn’t really explain the way I feel anymore. So me just...being open like this doesn’t mean I {i}want{/i} something.
lines.zh: : 在还不怎么了解你的时候，我说过很多话……现在已经不足以解释我的感受了。所以我这么……敞开心扉，并不代表我{i}想要{/i}什么。

lines.en: : I’m just in a good mood. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是心情好。就这样。

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome16
: I missed you just as much as everybody else.
lines.zh: : 我和其他人一样想你。

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome17
: N...Not getting a response to that...{i}is{/i} kind of embarrassing, though...
lines.zh: : 不、不过……说了这句没得到回应……还挺难为情的……

lines.en: : Sana...
lines.zh: : Sana……

lines.en: : Did something, like...{i}happen{/i} to you?
lines.zh: : 是不是{i}发生{/i}了什么……什么事？

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome18
: Other than you, you mean?
lines.zh: : 你是指除了你之外的事？

lines.en: : Yeah. Because I don’t think I alone could have made this sort of impact on you after one delusional night followed by two months of complete absence.
lines.zh: : 对。因为我不觉得光靠我自己，在一晚上的痴人说梦加上两个月的彻底消失之后，能对你造成这种程度的影响。

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome19
: Delusional, huh?
lines.zh: : 痴人说梦，是吗？

lines.en: : You know...maybe something {i}did{/i} happen.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……也许{i}确实{/i}发生了什么。

lines.en: : Maybe something {i}keeps{/i} happening. And I’m just not really sure how to talk about it or...even {i}start{/i} explaining it to anyone.
lines.zh: : 也许有什么事{i}一直{/i}在发生。而我只是不太确定该怎么开口，甚至该怎么向任何人解释。

lines.en: : That might just be a...side effect of never talking to anyone about {i}anything,{/i} though...
lines.zh: : 不过这大概只是……从来不跟任何人谈{i}任何事{/i}的副作用……

lines.en: : You can relate to that...can’t you?
lines.zh: : 这点你应该能理解吧……？

lines.en: : Even with Ayane...it’s not like I can just tell her how I feel. Or let her know about the stuff that scares me...because it’ll just make things more complicated and...before I know it, she’ll be stressed too...
lines.zh: : 即便是 Ayane……我也没法就这么告诉她我的感受。或者让她知道那些让我害怕的东西……因为那只会让事情变得更复杂，然后……不知不觉她也会跟着有压力……

lines.en: : You’re stressed about something?
lines.zh: : 你在为什么事压力很大吗？

lines.en: : You’d be stressed too if you were stuck in this body. But it’s not just that I’ve been troubled by lately...it’s everything.
lines.zh: : 如果你被困在这副身体里，你也会有压力的。但最近困扰我的不只是这个……是一切。

lines.en: : You see...I keep having these weird dreams where I can hear my brother’s voice, but I never get to {i}see{/i} him. And what I {i}do{/i} see is impossible to even describe.
lines.zh: : 你看……我老是做一些奇怪的梦，梦里能听见我哥哥的声音，却从来{i}见{/i}不到他。而我{i}看到{/i}的东西，根本无法描述。

lines.en: : They’re really creepy dreams, actually. They’re even...kind of cool in hindsight. Like, maybe I’m actually pretty creative after all?
lines.zh: : 其实那些梦挺吓人的。不过现在回想起来……甚至还有点酷。比如，也许我其实还挺有想象力的？

lines.en: : What does your brother tell you in those dreams?
lines.zh: : 你哥哥在那些梦里对你说什么？

lines.en: : Stuff that’s...not too different from the kind of stuff Yasu normally says. But he sounds a lot less crazy when he talks about it...
lines.zh: : 一些……和 Yasu 平时说的差不多的东西。但从他嘴里说出来，就没那么疯了……

lines.en: : And even if they’re just dreams, they’ve got me thinking that there might be more to life than this.
lines.zh: : 而且哪怕那只是梦，也让我开始想，人生也许不止眼前这些。

lines.en: : Maybe...just trying to keep things the way they are is a waste of my time?
lines.zh: : 也许……光是试着让一切维持原样，就是在浪费我的时间？

lines.en: : I only get one life...so why don’t I try to make the best of it? Because...for all I know, {i}I{/i} could get stabbed to death tomorrow and this would all be over without me having ever {i}loved{/i} anything.
lines.zh: : 我只有一辈子……那我为什么不尽力把它过好呢？因为……说不定{i}我{/i}明天就被人捅死了，一切就这么结束，而我从未{i}爱过{/i}任何东西。

lines.en: : The thought of that is pretty scary, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 想到这个还挺可怕的，不是吗？

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome20
: You said you lost something, didn’t you? Something you {i}loved.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你说你失去了什么，对吧？你{i}爱过{/i}的东西。

lines.en: : What was it like? That feeling. {i}Love.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那是什么感觉？那种感觉。{i}爱{/i}。

lines.en: : It was horrible.
lines.zh: : 糟透了。

lines.en: : I’d kill to have it back.
lines.zh: : 我愿意为了把它找回来而杀人。

lines.en: : Do you think you ever can?...
lines.zh: : 你觉得你还找得回来吗？……

lines.en: : I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome21
: I think that’s fine.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这样就好。

lines.en: : You don’t need to know everything about your future now.
lines.zh: : 你不需要现在就把未来的一切都弄明白。

lines.en: : Because, even if you feel lost, there’s always the possibility that something will appear out of nowhere and show you what you really want out of life.
lines.zh: : 因为，哪怕你感到迷茫，也总有可能会有某个东西凭空出现，告诉你真正想从人生里得到什么。

lines.en: : Do you think that’s what those “dreams” of yours are trying to do?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你那些“梦”想做的就是这个吗？

lines.en: : Trying, maybe. But I’m not sure if they’re having the right effect on me.
lines.zh: : 也许是想吧。但我不确定它们对我有没有起到正确的效果。

lines.en: : I’m changing...yeah...but how much of that is because of those and how much of it is because of what I’m experiencing outside of them?
lines.zh: : 我在改变……是啊……可这当中有多少是因为那些梦，又有多少是因为我在梦之外经历的事？

lines.en: : It’s not a thing you can measure...
lines.zh: : 这不是能衡量的东西……

lines.en: : I think I just want to be happy.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我只是想要幸福。

lines.en: : And I’m not sure if I’ve ever really felt that way before.
lines.zh: : 而我不确定自己以前是否真的有过那种感觉。

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome22
: Did any of that make sense to you? Or do I just sound kind of crazy now?
lines.zh: : 我说的这些你听得懂吗？还是说我现在听起来有点疯？

lines.en: : It made sense. And I’m sure you’re not far off in saying that our dreams can show us what it is we want out of life. Because I’ve been having the same dream lately too, and...
lines.zh: : 听得懂。而且你说梦能告诉我们想从人生里得到什么，我觉得你说得一点不差。因为最近我也一直在做同样的梦，而……

lines.en: : And what I see in those dreams is the {i}only{/i} thing I want right now.
lines.zh: : 而我在那些梦里看到的东西，是我现在{i}唯一{/i}想要的。

lines.en: : Then take it.
lines.zh: : 那就拿回来啊。

lines.en: : I can’t {i}do{/i} that because it’s the same thing I lost. Which is why all I want to do is sleep now since it’s the only time I ever get to see {i}it.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我{i}做{/i}不到，因为那正是我失去的东西。所以我现在只想睡觉，因为那是我唯一能看到{i}它{/i}的时刻。

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome23
: Then...I hope you find something else. Something attainable.
lines.zh: : 那么……我希望你能找到别的什么。某种可以够得到的东西。

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome24
: There was something else I dreamt too, Sana.
lines.zh: : Sana，我还梦到了别的东西。

lines.en: : Is that so?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Though, it might not have been a dream. It could have been some sort of delusion. That does happen unfortunately often.
lines.zh: : 不过那也许不是梦。可能是某种幻觉。不幸的是，这种事确实经常发生。

lines.en: : So I’ve heard.
lines.zh: : 我也听说过。

lines.en: : I’m talking about you.
lines.zh: : 我说的是你。

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome25
: In the dream or...vision or...delusion or whatever you want to call it, you were there. But it wasn’t {i}you{/i} as you are now.
lines.zh: : 在那个梦……或者幻象……或者幻觉……随便你怎么叫它，你在里面。但那不是现在的{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : It was years from now, in the future. And...I remember that you were the only person I had left.
lines.zh: : 那是多年以后、未来的你。而且……我记得你是我仅剩的唯一一个人。

lines.en: : Everyone else was gone. And...And I think you loved me. But I was so broken at the time that I’m not sure I loved you back.
lines.zh: : 其他所有人都不在了。而且……而且我想你是爱我的。但我当时破碎得那么厉害，我不确定自己有没有回应你的爱。

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome26
: You’d come to my house...make me dinner...have sex with me...then you’d curl up in a ball and sleep by my side until it was time for you to go back home.
lines.zh: : 你会来我家……给我做晚饭……和我做爱……然后蜷成一团睡在我身边，直到你该回家的时候。

lines.en: : It was like having an entire second life inside of my head. And it all felt so real and so...{i}comfortable.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那就像在我脑子里存在着完整的第二人生。一切都那么真实、那么……{i}舒服{/i}。

lines.en: : But at the same time, it filled me with such a great deal of dread that I’m terrified even trying to recall it right now.
lines.zh: : 但与此同时，它又让我充满了巨大的恐惧，以至于现在光是试着回忆，我都会害怕。

lines.en: : Why was it you? Why were {i}you{/i} the girl who stayed with me when, with all due respect, I’m so much closer to almost everyone else?
lines.zh: : 为什么是你？恕我直言，我和几乎其他所有人都亲近得多，为什么{i}你{/i}是那个留下来陪我的女孩？

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome27
: Huh.
: Do I ever get taller?
lines.zh: : 我会长高吗？

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome28
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : When I’m older...Do I keep growing? Or is this just going to be my height for the rest of my life?
lines.zh: : 等我长大以后……我还会继续长吗？还是说这辈子就这么高了？

lines.en: : {i}That’s{/i} your first question? Why?
lines.zh: : {i}这{/i}是你的第一个问题？为什么问这个？

lines.en: : I’m trying to envision it...and I can only picture the way you look from all the way down here.
lines.zh: : 我在试着想象它……可我只能记起从这么低的地方仰头看你时你的样子。

lines.en: : What did the house look like?...What color were the cabinets?...
lines.zh: : 那房子是什么样的？……橱柜是什么颜色的？……

lines.en: scene walkingsanahome29
: They were blue.
lines.zh: : 是蓝色的。

lines.en: : There were checkerboard tiles covering the floor...and a vase of roses near the entryway beside a coat rack full of things I never wore.
lines.zh: : 地板上铺着棋盘格的瓷砖……玄关旁有个插着玫瑰的花瓶，旁边是挂满了我从没穿过的东西的衣帽架。

lines.en: : The windows were boarded and there was an ugly carpet in front of the sink where fish would appear once per week.
lines.zh: : 窗户被木板钉死了，水槽前有块难看的地毯，每周会有一次鱼出现在那儿。

lines.en: : A voice on the PA above the door would announce the weather for the day and remind me that I shouldn’t ever leave. And I’d spend my free time either writing or watching porn.
lines.zh: : 门上方的广播里会有声音播报当天的天气，提醒我永远不要出门。而我的空闲时间不是在写作，就是在看色情片。

lines.en: : The table was a clock...I had a parrot and a squirrel...and the cabinet above the stove wore a wig and loved the Notebook.
lines.zh: : 桌子是一只钟……我养过一只鹦鹉和一只松鼠……炉子上方的橱柜戴着假发，还爱看《恋恋笔记本》。

lines.en: : Should I stop now? Is it getting too weird?
lines.zh: : 我要停了吗？是不是太奇怪了？

lines.en: : No...keep going.
lines.zh: : 不……继续。

lines.en: : I want to see everything you saw.
lines.zh: : 我想看到你看到的一切。

lines.en: : But why?...Everything about it was just so...{i}wrong.{/i}
lines.zh: : 可为什么呢？……那里的一切都是那么……{i}不对劲{/i}。

lines.en: : It’s simple, really.
lines.zh: : 很简单，真的。

lines.en: scene black
: It might be the only future I ever get to have with you.
lines.zh: : 那也许是我唯一能和你拥有的未来。

lines.en: I finish explaining the room in my head to Sana...and she never once calls me insane despite how badly I deserve it.
lines.zh: 我把脑海里的那个房间向 Sana 描述完……而她自始至终没有说过我疯了，尽管我完全配得上这个评价。

lines.en: And I wish she would have-
lines.zh: 而我倒希望她说了——

lines.en: Because the smile on her face brings me closer to comfort than I am comfortable with.
lines.zh: 因为她脸上的笑容，把我带到了一种让我自己都不安的舒适里。

lines.en: Has she always been this beautiful? This {i}calming?{/i}
lines.zh: 她一直都这么美吗？这么{i}让人平静{/i}吗？

lines.en: Is {i}this{/i} why it was her in there with me? Have I known it all along and just pushed it aside in favor of those a bit less angelic?
lines.zh: 难道{i}这{/i}就是在那个未来里陪着我的人是她的原因？难道我其实一直都知道，只是把它推到一边，去偏爱那些不那么像天使的人？

lines.en: These are questions I don’t want to have because I know they can’t be answered.
lines.zh: 这些都是我不想要的问题，因为我知道它们没有答案。

lines.en: And even if they could, I fear the way the results would make me feel.
lines.zh: 而就算有，我也害怕那个答案会让我有什么感觉。

lines.en: Because when feeling {i}anything{/i} is like a dagger in my heart, this overabundance of longing does naught but cut the cords that hold it up.
lines.zh: 因为当{i}任何感觉{/i}都像插在心口的一把匕首时，这份过量的渴望只会割断吊着它的那些绳子。

lines.en: If {i}she{/i} were still here, she’d call me disgusting.
lines.zh: 如果{i}她{/i}还在，她会说我恶心。

lines.en: She’d be right.
lines.zh: 她说得对。

lines.en: So I grit my teeth to prevent this new wave of feelings from flowing in.
lines.zh: 所以我咬紧牙关，不让新一波感情涌进来。

lines.en: I don’t want them to wash away what’s left of {i}her.{/i}
lines.zh: 我不想让它们把{i}她{/i}仅剩的部分冲走。
